hostname.description: The hostname of the host managed by the VEN

uid.description: The unique ID of the host managed by the VEN

os_id.description: OS identifier of the host managed by the VEN

os_detail.description: Additional OS details from the host managed by the VEN

os_platform.description: OS platform of the host managed by the VEN

activation_type.description: The method by which the VEN was activated

active_pce_fqdn.description: The FQDN of the PCE that the VEN last connected to

target_pce_fqdn.description: The FQDN of the PCE that the VEN will use for future connections

golden_image.description: Indicates whether this VEN is a golden image

labels.description: Labels assigned to the host managed by the VEN.

key.description: Key of the label, only present in expanded representations.

value.description: Value of the label, only present in expanded representations.

interfaces.description: Network interfaces of the host managed by the VEN.

name.description: The short friendly name of the workload, only present in expanded representations.

managed.description: True if the workload is managed, else false

hostname.description: The hostname of the workload, only present in expanded representations.

os_id.description: OS identifier for the workload, only present in expanded representations.

os_detail.description: Additional OS details, only present in expanded representations.

labels.description: Labels assigned to the workload., only present in expanded representations.

public_ip.description: The public IP of the server, only present in expanded representations.

interfaces.description: Network interfaces of the workload, only present in expanded representations.

security_policy_applied_at.description: Last reported time when policy was applied to the workload (UTC), only present in expanded representations.

security_policy_received_at.description: Last reported time when policy was received by the workload (UTC), only present in expanded representations.

security_policy_last_delivered_at.description: Last time when policy was delivered (UTC)

security_policy_last_delivered_num_cidrs.description: Number of IP addresses or CIDR ranges in last delivered policy

security_policy_last_delivered_num_rules.description: Number of rules in last delivered policy

log_traffic.description: DEPRECATED AND REMOVED. True if we want to log traffic events from this workload, only present in expanded representations.

mode.description: Policy enforcement mode, only present in expanded representations.

enforcement_mode.description: Policy enforcement mode, only present in expanded representations.

visibility_level.description: Visibility level of the workload, only present in expanded representations.

online.description: If this workload is online and present in policy, only present in expanded representations.

href.description: The URI of the container cluster managed by this VEN

name.description: The name of the container cluster managed by this VEN, only present in expanded representations.

matching_issuer_name.description: Issuer name match criteria for certificate used during establishing secure connections.

last_heartbeat_at.description: The last time (rfc3339 timestamp) a heartbeat was received from this VEN

last_goodbye_at.description: The time (rfc3339 timestamp) of the last goodbye from the VEN

created_at.description: The time (rfc3339 timestamp) at which this VEN was created

href.description: The URI of the user who created this VEN

updated_at.description: The time (rfc3339 timestamp) at which this VEN was last updated

href.description: The URI of the user who last updated this VEN

authentication_recovery.description: Specifies if the VEN is in authentication recovery

upgrade_expires_at.description: The time (rfc3339 timestamp) at which the PCE stops attempting VEN upgrade

upgrade_target_version.description: The software release to upgrade to.
